name: decarlo-boyz
description: DECARLO BOYZ — an open-world Steel City game in Three.js. No art assets: every texture, mesh, animation and sound is generated procedurally at load time.
comment:scripts: SCRIPT NAMING IS PART OF THE CONTRACT. A probe with no entry here is not a gate, it is a file (ARCHITECTURE.md rule 9). Groups below, in order: build/dev · CHAINS · node-only gates (fast, no browser) · browser gates (each boots its own vite) · known-RED (runnable, deliberately unchained) · diag (reports that ALWAYS exit 0 — never chain these, they cannot fail). Costs and green/red status are tabulated in ARCHITECTURE.md under 'Which chain does my probe go in'.
